messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic-number field construction from elliptic curve packings

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration maximizing the minimum triangle area in the unit square is given by the images of the 13-torsion subgroup E[13] of a CM elliptic curve E with j-invariant 0 under a biholomorphic map to a fundamental parallelogram, followed by an affine transformation into [0,1]² that sends the period lattice basis to the unit square's edges. The algebraic coordinates of these points, lying in the ray class field of Q(√-3) of conductor 13, yield a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/84. This bound is optimal because the torsion points' equidistribution modulo the lattice forces every collinear triple to be absent and every triangle area to be a lattice-translated multiple of 1/84, with equality achieved by triples whose reductions modulo the lattice form an arithmetic progression in E[13]."}
